introspection.json in this directory is a VERBATIM copy. Do not edit it here.

  original: meta/fixtures/introspection.json
            (V-M-Pioneer-Trading/meta, repo root `fixtures/introspection.json`)
  meta commit: 46c033e3101dad46c0336e7d3cd74642a62248ab (2026-09-26)
  sha256: 5fe6d77e1113c05af899e554db0723a06cf42c197f9eb46a8b93b2f3c682201c

The sha256 above is the hash of the LF bytes of introspection.json and is
asserted by introspection_fixture_test.go, so the pin enforces itself instead
of relying on someone remembering to re-copy. The repository's .gitattributes
marks that one file `-text` so a Windows checkout (core.autocrlf=true) keeps
the same bytes a Linux checkout has and the hash holds on both.

The provenance lives in this sibling file rather than as a key inside the JSON
so the copy stays byte-identical to the original and `diff` is the drift check.
Change meta first, then re-copy and update the commit above.

auth-service is the CENTER, not a calling service: the `cases` and
`gatewayCases` describe what a *client* answers, which this repository does not
implement. What is normative here is the `contract` block (endpoint, method,
content type, body template, secret header, env var names) and every `center`
object inside a case — those are this service's own output. See
introspection_fixture_test.go, which drives the center through all of them.
